title: Frobenius-as-2-norm in pid_tuning tail bound; dedupe maxSingularValue/spectralNorm
body: pid_tuning.go:~791-801 normA = mat.Norm(plant.A,2) and cab=||CA||*||B|| use Frobenius in resolvent tail cb+cab/(w-normA): sound but loose (same class as YF7YLL); use spectralNorm. Also norms.go:~1058 maxSingularValue does 4 allocs/call; share spectralNorm's single-buffer min-workspace layout (and dedupe). spectralNorm setup costs +3 allocs on DiskMargin_PIDExactDelay.

title: TunePID returns unstable PID/PD design on exact-delay plants
body:
Found from process-lab ergo WUDBJU (branch ergo/WUDBJU, internal/studio/pid_delay_tune_test.go).
Repro: plant 1/(s+10) with exact input delay 2.1 s; TunePID family PID, default targets (no crossover), PM 60. Returns P=9.3985 I=-105.198 D=0; closed loop unstable. Also PID at delay 0.3 s gives P=-2.31 I=-179.5 D=-0.41; PD at 0.05 s gives D=-1.08.
Cause: stability screen for ideal-derivative PID/PD families is sampled-frequency only, so it misses instability from |Kd s G(s)| > 1 at high frequency with exact delay; also accepts the wrapped-phase branch giving negative gains.
Expected: refuse unstable / sign-inconsistent designs.
Process Lab currently compensates (refuses unstable evidence).

title: Neutral delay HinfNorm/IsStable residual undecided cases
body:
After Z4NJXY, still ErrDelayUnsupported: commensurate unequal delays (e.g. tau=(1,2)) stable but not strongly stable (needs grouped-delay/polynomial-root certificate); diagonal scaling tight only nd<=3; equal delays nd>1 with direct feedthrough: highFrequencyGain searches full torus, may refuse peak for proven-stable loops; Stein-only equal delays -> highFrequencyLipschitz +Inf. Also dde HinfNorm bench +2-3% from h22Det/loopDet split.

Progress (claude/delay-followups 8338503..c168ce2): (a) commensurate via lifted Stein, (c) one-phase HF gain, (d) finite Stein Lipschitz, (e) perf done. Open: (b) nd>=4 incommensurate strong-stability certificate (diag scaling tight only nd<=3); partly-commensurate delays (1,2,sqrt2) still one phase per value; no test for dim==1 peak at w=Inf with nd>1; zero internal delays sweep a phantom phase in highFrequencyGain.

title: TunePID default crossover ignores exact delay
body: Found from process-lab ergo WUDBJU. findCrossoverFreq picks the default crossover from the plant magnitude alone (1/(s+10) -> 9.976 rad/s) and ignores exact delay; with tau=2.1 s the phase budget is ~21 rad so the PM target is only met on a wrapped branch. Process Lab caps the default crossover at (180-PM)/(2 tau) (internal/studio/pid_session_tune.go pidDelayCrossoverLimit). Consider a delay-aware default in TunePID.
